budget: 50 training rounds with the original real-LT steps per round for every cell, NOT 50 full passes over each augmented pool. Fixed AdamW update count and schedule.
confirmation: No new official test scoring until all 192 checkpoints are independently validated and bound by a new evaluation seal. Final checkpoint, tau=0, report all doses.
controls: Real-only natural and uniform sampling; duplicate-real pools exactly match every augmented class count. All use unweighted CE, no EQ, tau=0.
dose_rule: Per-class floor(dose*(maximum real fit class count-real fit class count)); nested image-index prefixes

gpu_assignment: Each synthetic-minus-duplicate seed pair shares one GPU; seed groups rotate each condition over all four GPUs (three seeds per GPU). Four disjoint writers.

limits: One public pretrained generator and one generation bank; cannot prove a universal ceiling or from-scratch generative-data impossibility.
Generator external pretraining may overlap benchmark concepts or data; exact downsampled image duplication checked, pretraining independence is not established.
The real official test set has already been evaluated in the primary study; follow-up protocol is frozen before new experiment results, not before the original study.
Intended prompt labels can be semantically wrong. No sample selection based on test accuracy or a label-quality filter.
Frozen encoders and adapter adaptation; not an end-to-end vision training benchmark. No new tuning or best-dose selection on confirmation.
primary_contrasts: Six synthetic-minus-matched-duplicate macro-F1 differences (3 doses x 2 encoders), 12 paired training seeds; exact sign-flip and Holm across six. Conditional on one generation bank and one real split.
scope: Separate post-hoc CIFAR-100 LT100 generated-image dose experiment
secondary: Dose increments, uniform-real control, head/middle/tail F1 and per-class results, explicitly exploratory.
standardizer: Real original fit-only scaler, fixed across all synthetic and duplicate controls within each encoder.
